full_text:
The Organization uses a number of different vehicles for its missions, with many of them stored in their bases all around the globe. 
== Black Sedans ==
The most common vehicle of choice for the Organization, these cars are used to transport operatives to and from their missions. They are often used for surveillance and espionage, with Suits keeping tabs on enemy Seekers from afar. 
=== Trivia ===
*The black sedans are based on the Chrysler 300c Touring models.

== Choppers ==
Combat Choppers are large blue helicopters that are used by the Organization for aerial combat. They are armed to the teeth with powerful missiles. Two of these choppers attacked the Huntik team's jet in Vienna, Austria but were brought down by Metagolem and King Basilisk respectively. [The Bookshop Hunter] Wilder sent a combat chopper to destroy the Huntik team but failed and the chopper exploded. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

== Stealth Vessel ==
A large stealth watercraft was used by Wilder and his team to travel to the coast of England undetected as they followed the Huntik team on their mission to the Crystal Caves to find the location of Avalon. [Cave of the Casterwills] 

== Speedboats ==
Speedboats are used for water travel. Wilder and his team used these to travel to Avalon. Grier's Suits also use these to bring supplies from the Greek Mainland to Sutos Island. [An Ally from the Organization]

== White Automobile ==
A white automobile was used to personally transport Wilder to the Road of Alchemists and, later, to take Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill and Cherit back to Organization Central. It was destroyed when Lok summoned Powerbonded Baselaird inside it, blowing it apart and sending its driver flying. [Chasing Void]
